title.en: The corpus's candidate theorems of the grammar, tested
title.zh: 语料中文法之候选定理之检验

statement.en: Of the first batch's 59 candidate theorems of the grammar, 38 hold for every carrier and relation, 15 hold only under a premise, 3 fail, 2 were misclassified and 1 is not expressible; the premises most often needed are double-negation stability and that nothing is its own condition.
statement.zh: 第一批 59 个文法之候选定理中，38 个对每个载体与关系成立，15 个只在前提下成立，3 个不成立，2 个归类有误，1 个不可表达；最常需要的前提是双重否定之稳定与无物自缘。

laws.en: Correlatives that are the two ends of one relation, a condition and its result, the goer and the going, are had together: each exactly where the other is; two independent relations have no such law.
laws.zh: 一关系之两端相待（缘与果、去者与去）：各恰在另一有处有；两个独立之关系无此律。

laws.en: A mark gives its complement a mark; that the complement gives the mark back, for every carrier, is exactly double-negation stability, and holds for a decided two-valued reading.
laws.zh: 有相则非亦有相；自非还于其相，对一切载体成立，恰是双重否定之稳定；对可判定之二值读法成立。
declarations: Becoming.«相待之还当且仅当双非可还»

laws.en: An occurrence begins under some class and not under another exactly where it is not-not conditioned and is not its own condition; its own condition abides under every class; everything ends under identity exactly where nothing is its own condition.
laws.zh: 一事在某类下生而在另一类下不生，恰在其非不受缘且不自缘时；自缘者在每一类下皆住；在相等之类下一切皆灭，恰在无物自缘时。
declarations: Becoming.«念念灭当且仅当无自缘»

laws.en: Every condition strictly precedes its result exactly where the net has no cycle, and a cycle of 缘 is one co-present cluster.
laws.zh: 每一缘严格先于其果，恰在网无环时；缘之环为一同时之聚。
declarations: Becoming.«缘先果后当且仅当无环»

laws.en: The core is never separated at a finite stage; the converse fails in an infinitely branching net, and holds where the class read is symmetric and the relation of no separating stage is itself constant.
laws.zh: 核在有穷之层永不被分；其逆在无穷分支之网中不成立，而在所读之类对称、且“无分之层”之关系本身有常时成立。
declarations: Becoming.«不可致诘而有常则混而为一»

hypotheses.en: Each reading of a sentence is an AI reconstruction; the outcome table records what the reading loses.
hypotheses.zh: 每一句之读法是 AI 重构；结果表记录读法所失。

does_not_show.en: That the corpus states the grammar: 有無相生 and 四相俱時, the plan's own examples, need a premise, and several 中论 lines need that nothing is its own condition, which the grammar does not assume.
does_not_show.zh: 语料陈述本文法：计划自己的例子有無相生与四相俱時都需前提，《中论》数句需“无物自缘”，而文法不设之。

does_not_show.en: That every condition precedes its result: a net may have cycles of 缘.
does_not_show.zh: 每一缘都先于其果：网可有缘之环。

detail.en: An infinitely branching net where no finite stage separates two occurrences outside one core class («致诘不尽»).
detail.zh: 无穷分支之网：有穷之层不分两事，而二者不在一核类（«致诘不尽»）。

validation_scope.en: Checked by the core checker with Lean 4.29.1 from the prelude: Becoming.GrammarCandidates, 69 theorems in 93 declarations, each with an empty axiom report. Written by an Opus coder from the first-batch classification; no person's audit of the readings recorded.
validation_scope.zh: 由核心检查器以 Lean 4.29.1 从前奏检查：Becoming.GrammarCandidates，93 个声明中 69 条定理，公理报告皆空。由一位 Opus 编者据第一批分类写成；读法尚无人审核之记录。

next_delta.en: Test the second round's candidates (中论 chapters 10, 17, 19, 24, 成唯识论, 五教章), and decide with the classical review whether 不自生 is a premise of the texts or a reading of them.
next_delta.zh: 检验第二轮之候选（中论第十、十七、十九、二十四品，成唯识论，五教章），并与古文审查一同判断“不自生”是文本之前提还是对文本之读。

history.en: 23 October 2026, board item OU2c (study section 381): the first batch's class-乙 units tested in Lean.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日，工作板条目 OU2c（研究第 381 节）：第一批乙类单元在 Lean 中检验。

history.en: 25 October 2026, board item DF (study section 418): the statement gives all five outcomes of the batch (2 misclassified and 1 not expressible added); the fifth law names the symmetry of the class read that its converse takes; the Lean is unchanged.
history.zh: 2026年10月25日，工作板条目 DF（研究第 418 节）：陈述给出该批的全部五种结果（增列 2 个归类有误、1 个不可表达）；第五条定律写明其逆所需的所读之类之对称；Lean 不变。

history.en: 31 October 2026, board item HE2, items 6 and 7 (study section 474): «从缘生非文法之理» renamed to «从缘生非文法之律», with no alias kept: its 理 meant a law of the grammar, and the two conditions it names are conditions on a model; no statement's content changes.
history.zh: 2026年10月31日，工作板条目 HE2 之第 6、7 项（研究第 474 节）：«从缘生非文法之理» 改为 «从缘生非文法之律»，不留别名：其理意为文法之律，所言二者是对模型之条件；所述之义皆不变。

history.en: 6 November 2026, board item LM: `«四相俱时»` moves to Grammar, where `«四相无自立»` is proved from it, and `«缕之无定性»`, three of its four positions, is removed; the names change here and no law does.
history.zh: 2026年11月6日，工作板条目 LM：`«四相俱时»` 移至 Grammar，`«四相无自立»` 由之得证；`«缕之无定性»` 为其四相之三，删去；此处改名，诸律不变。
